preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 2 and 200,000.
The price of each vertex is between 0 and 10^9.
Each edge connects two vertices within the tree.

postconditions.expression: s is the minimum possible cost Arkady has to pay to guarantee his own win
postconditions.description: Arkady needs to find the minimum total cost he has to pay on the first stage to guarantee his own win.

postconditions.expression: k is the number of vertices that belong to at least one optimal set
postconditions.description: Arkady needs to find all such vertices that there is an optimal set of vertices containing this one such that he can guarantee his own win.

postconditions.expression: The output contains the integers s and k followed by k distinct integers in increasing order
postconditions.description: The output should include the minimum cost and the list of vertices that belong to at least one optimal set.
